the Boolean autoencoder, a non linear autoencoder that is a fundamental component of deep architectures, is equivalent to a polynomial time clustering problem when the number of classes is small and to a NP complete clustering problem when the classes are large, and that the framework that we developed for the analysis of Boolean autoencoders can be applied to other autoencoders, including the linear autoencoder and the real autoencoder.
